headline: Clean: Navy Blue and Silver Plus are uniquely determined, and the documented eligibility rules force opening both new accounts before either closure.
solution_check: Business checking: a genuine $0 monthly fee, no minimum balance and not startup-only leave only Navy Blue (Cobalt $20, Hunter/Lime $25, True Blue $75, World Blue $50, Beige $200, Sky Blue $0 only for a 6-month free period). Savings: a $2.5-3k balance, 10-15 withdrawals, daily compounding, relationship bonus and ATM rebates give Silver Plus. Ordering: general_003 requires 'no accounts with status CLOSED' for business checking. general_002 needs a checking account held at least 14 days for savings; Evergreen is 244 days old, Light Blue 12 days. So both openings must precede both closures. Then $150 Bronze -> Silver Plus, close Bronze, $2,500 and $1,000 out of Evergreen, close Evergreen. Replays: swapping the two openings gives the same state, while opening business checking after any closure fails. This matches the gold.
prior_note: The prior review also rated this clean; that still holds, though the two closures depend on the verified scorer (see notes).
notes: Scorer dependence: two close_bank_account_7392 calls store free-text closure_reason, which the verified scorer ignores; under upstream grading a non-default reason fails. The Bronze savings is stored with class 'saving' (not 'savings'), so close_bank_account_7392 finds no early-closure config. It is 674 days old, so no fee would apply anyway. The verification info omits a phone; the gold logs DB phone 206-555-0847. Notice periods in general_005/006 (7 days Evergreen, 1 day Bronze) are undefined; the gold closes immediately.
